standard: Visibly improved from the original preview and acceptable at normal app scale. This is Beta candidate visual acceptance, not an 8/10 quality score or production release approval.

front.note: The five-book stack now has distinct thin cover boards, recessed pages and articulated spines instead of rounded solid blocks. The retained offsets and palette remain legible at normal catalog scale.

rear.note: Full-size inspection shows the finer page surface now reads as smooth paper rather than large cloth weave. Cover overhangs separate the pageblocks cleanly; the low-contrast white top cover is an acceptable palette limitation.

detail.note: Spine rules and small title panels are seated within the binding construction. Paper and covers separate visibly. The inherited glossy blue binding and blank title panels are acceptable stylized finishes at app scale.

underside.note: The bottom green cover closes the stack, and the layered foreedges remain bounded with no detached construction visible. The original stacking arrangement is retained.

clay.note: The untextured view confirms physical cover lips and inset pageblocks; the improvement survives without material detail. The books retain their individually readable stacked silhouettes.

front.note: Seven books retain their varied original heights and positions while thinner covers and recessed pages replace pill-like solids. The row reads more clearly as bound books than the original preview.

rear.note: Rear foreedges show contained pale pageblocks between separate cover boards. The fine paper scale avoids the former large weave; none of the books presents an open or detached rear assembly.

detail.note: Full-size inspection confirms thin spine panels and rules, cover edges and fine paper tops. Cloth texture stays on cloth covers; the retained glossy blue cover and text-free labels are acceptable at app scale.

underside.note: The pageblocks remain inset at the bottom edges and the covers form closed book bodies. The existing differing base levels follow the authored arrangement without a new floating detail.

clay.note: The seven separate bodies, cover borders and bound spines remain readable with materials removed. The geometry is visibly more constructed than the original rounded blocks.

front.note: The original tall shelving silhouette and filled shelf arrangement remain recognizable, with improved timber surface and visible book spine accents. Improvement is restrained but visible at app scale.

rear.note: The inset brown back panel is seated within the timber perimeter with consistent edges. The broad plain backing is acceptable for the retained simple shelf construction.

detail.note: Full-size inspection shows finer timber and added book spine/title construction. The grain is still prominent on shelf noses and pale spines have low contrast, but neither obscures the furniture at normal room scale.

underside.note: Shelf boards, side supports and book rows remain aligned without detached additions. The original filled poses naturally hide most paper foreedges; no book rearrangement is required for this candidate.

clay.note: The retained shelf thicknesses and separate rows read coherently without textures. Subtle book construction is secondary at this framing, while the recognizable original structure remains intact.

front.note: Tone-on-tone quilting and softer pillow bodies improve the original bed, but the pillow piping rear edges are visibly raised away from the cloth. Refit the piping to the final pillow surface before acceptance.

rear.note: The upholstered back and mattress remain coherent, and the calmer duvet rules improve the previous bright strip effect. This view does not resolve the detached pillow trim visible from the front.

detail.note: Blocking defect: both pillow trim loops float above their rear pillow edges against the headboard; a clear gap is visible. The piping must follow the reshaped pillow rather than its former outline.

underside.note: The original concealed platform base remains bounded and the mattress/frame layers are recognizable. No additional underside defect blocks review; the required correction is the pillow trim contact.

clay.note: The pale piping loops remain visibly suspended above the rear pillow corners even without colored materials, confirming a geometry/contact defect rather than a texture or lighting artifact.

front.note: The three-seat silhouette and connected arms are retained, while softer cushion crowns and restrained corner compression visibly improve the blockier original preview. The matte green finish remains coherent.

rear.note: Full-size inspection shows the backing and arms remain connected around the cushion row. The broad rear fabric panel is simple but visually consistent; subtle surface grain does not dominate it.

detail.note: Full-size inspection confirms restrained cushion dents and small edge folds with clean contact between seats and backs. No coarse basket weave or loose side cushions have been introduced; repeated corner treatment is acceptable at room scale.

underside.note: Four slim metal supports remain attached to the continuous lower frame. The dark bottom panel is closed, and no new floating trim or exposed gap is visible in this view.

clay.note: The cushion loft and compression remain visible without textures, providing a genuine geometry improvement. Seats keep rounded rectangular furniture forms and do not become disconnected blobs.

front.note: The shade now has a clear open top and believable shell thickness, improving the original capped cone. The compact terracotta base and timber stem preserve the recognizable lamp silhouette.

rear.note: The reverse view retains a continuous shade shell and clean stem/base alignment. The restrained linen surface supports the simple handcrafted design without a distracting seam.

detail.note: Full-size inspection shows fine shade fibers, a thin lower rim, timber grain on the stem and a softly finished ceramic body. There is no new coarse surface treatment or oversized decorative hardware.

underside.note: Full-size inspection confirms an open shade interior with connected radial supports and a central fitting, replacing the original solid cap. The slightly irregular base ring is retained and acceptable for the ceramic construction.

clay.note: The open top and shaped shade shell remain visible without materials, proving the construction improvement. Base, stem and shade keep a coherent original profile.

limitation: Visual notes refer only to the exact viewed contact-sheet artifacts. Recipe inputs changed before recording. Rebuild, rerender and inspect new images before recording any approval.
